spells.name: Switcheroo!
spells.description: Jinx swaps weapons between Fishbones the rocket launcher and Pow-Pow the minigun. While using the rocket launcher, Jinx's Attacks deal physical damage to the target and nearby enemies, gain range, cost Mana, and scale % less with bonus Attack Speed. While using the minigun, Jinx's Attacks grant Attack Speed for seconds, stacking up to times (+% %i:scaleAS% max).
spells.coverageNote: The generic direct-damage evaluator preserves the structured formula and complete rank arrays. The full patch description is retained and assigned to the stacking-proc family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.
